question: As of November 2026, who is the President and CEO of Walmart Inc.?
answer: John Furner is the president and CEO of Walmart Inc. as of November 2026 [3][8]. A Business Wire release dated November 12, 2026, names him as president and chief executive officer and says he will host the third-quarter earnings call on November 19, 2026 [8]. Wikipedia (dated November 11, 2026) also lists him as president and CEO and describes Doug McMillon as the former president and CEO [3].
